DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所について、追加の確認をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check something further about your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所変更の控えを見たら、部屋番号を逆に書いていました。引っ越しはもう済んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居済みで住所変更控えの部屋番号を逆に書いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I checked my copy of the address change, I saw that I had reversed the room number. I have already moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have already moved and wrote the room number in reverse on your address-change copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前回の変更内容の訂正として、担当者に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's consult the responsible staff about correcting the previous change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう一度転居したわけではありません。この控えと正しい番号を示せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再転居ではなく控えと正番号で訂正相談するべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't moved again. Should I show this copy and the correct number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether to consult about a correction using your copy and the correct number, since you have not moved again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できる情報を担当者へ提示してください。どこに誤記があるかも説明しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show the staff the information you can verify. Explain where the mistake is too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 建物名までは合っています。最後の部屋番号だけ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 建物名は正しく部屋番号のみ直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The building name is correct. I only want to correct the room number at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the building name is correct and only the room number needs correcting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知の送付先などへの反映も含めて確認します。まだ届いていない通知はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll also check how this affects addresses for notices. Are there any notices that haven't arrived yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待っている通知があります。誤った番号のまま送られていないか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待つ通知があり誤番号宛てに送られていないか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm waiting for a notice. I want to know whether it has been sent to the incorrect number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are waiting for a notice and ask whether it has been sent to the wrong number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送付状況を確認できるか担当者に照会します。訂正だけですべての送付が変わるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the staff whether they can check its dispatch status. A correction alone may not change every mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 訂正の結果と待っている通知の扱いを分けて聞き、完了した項目を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所訂正と通知の扱いを分けて聞き完了項目を記録すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask separately about the correction's result and the notice I'm waiting for, and record which items are complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask separately about the address correction and handling of the notice, and record completed items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認事項を担当者へ引き継ぎます。控えは捨てずにお持ちください。私は担当者を呼んでまいりますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass these questions to the responsible staff. Keep your copy rather than discarding it. I'll go and call the staff now; excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 召し上がり方の表示をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the instructions for eating it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰ってすぐ食べたいのですが、この食品はそのままでよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅後すぐ食べる食品をそのまま食べてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to eat as soon as I get home. Can this food be eaten as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether food you want to eat immediately after getting home can be eaten as it is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品の表示には、加熱してからと書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product's label says to heat it before eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見た目だけで出来上がっていると思いました。今日は調理する時間がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見た目で完成品と思ったが調理する時間がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I assumed from its appearance that it was ready to eat. I don't have time to cook today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you thought it was ready to eat from its appearance, but have no time to cook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま食べられる商品を探す場合も、個別の表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even when looking for ready-to-eat products, please check each one's own label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の商品を比べます。味付けの材料と保存方法も、同じものと思わず読んでみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別商品について味付け材料と保存法を個別に読むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll compare another product. I'll read its seasoning ingredients and storage method separately too, rather than assuming they are the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will read another product's seasoning ingredients and storage method individually. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な確認項目を分けて見ていただくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's good to examine the different points you need to check separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらは食べ方がわかりました。冷蔵の表示もあるので、持ち帰り方を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食べ方がわかり冷蔵表示を踏まえ持ち帰り方も考えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand how to eat this one. It also says refrigerated, so I want to consider how to take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you understand the eating instructions and also want to consider transport home because refrigeration is indicated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入後も表示の保存条件をご確認ください。読めない箇所があれば担当者にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the storage conditions on the label after purchase too. If there is anything you cannot read, ask the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食べ方と材料と保存法を確認できたものだけ選び、最初の商品は今回は戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食べ方材料保存を確認できた商品を選び最初の商品を戻すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose only a product whose eating instructions, ingredients and storage I have checked, and put the first one back this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose a product with confirmed eating instructions, ingredients and storage, and return the first product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示を確かめてから選び直されるのですね。お帰りまで保存方法に気を配って、お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: So you're checking the labels before choosing again. Mind the storage method until you get home, and enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 買い物のお荷物をお持ちですが、これから散歩なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're carrying shopping bags. Are you going for a walk now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 普段は遠くまで歩きますが、今日は袋が重いので短くしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 普段は長距離だが今日は買物袋が重く短く歩きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I usually walk a long way, but my bags are heavy today, so I'd like a short walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you usually walk a long distance, but want a shorter walk today because your shopping bags are heavy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつもと違う負担があるのですね。戻る場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you have a different burden today. Have you decided where you will return to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この入口に戻ります。袋を置いて先へ行くつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同入口へ戻り袋を放置して歩かないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll return to this entrance. I don't intend to leave my bags behind and walk farther.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will return to the same entrance and will not leave your bags unattended to walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物を手元で管理しながら、無理のない距離をお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consider a manageable distance while keeping your belongings with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち替えながら歩ける短い道を、案内図で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を持ち替えて歩く短い道を図で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to see a short route on the map where I can walk while switching the bags between hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check a short route on the map for walking while changing hands with your bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図の表示を確認しましょう。休憩できるかは現地の状況も見る必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the map's symbols. Whether you can rest also depends on the conditions there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 空いていれば休みたいですが、必ず座れるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空席なら休むが必ず座れると思わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to rest if a seat is free, but I won't assume I can definitely sit down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will rest if there is a free seat, but will not assume seating is guaranteed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物の重さを踏まえて、引き返す目安も決めておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Considering the bags' weight, let's also decide when to turn back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最初の曲がり角で腕の疲れを確かめ、つらければ先へ行かず入口に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 初めの角で腕の疲れを見てつらければ入口へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check how tired my arms are at the first corner. If it's difficult, I'll return to the entrance rather than going farther.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check arm fatigue at the first corner and return to the entrance if it is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は荷物とご自身の負担を優先してください。短い散歩でも無理をせず、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today, prioritize your bags and the strain on yourself. Even on a short walk, don't overdo it, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族が階段のほうへ進まれましたね。ご一緒に改札へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your family headed toward the stairs. Are you going to the ticket gates together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ベビーカーを押しているので、階段へそのまま進めません。家族と別の経路で合流したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 階段を進めないため先行する家族とは別経路で合流したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm pushing a stroller, so I can't just continue to the stairs. I'd like to meet my family by taking another route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot use the stairs and want to meet your family ahead by a different route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内図でエレベーターへの道を見ましょう。いま、ご家族へ連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at the route to the elevator on the map. Can you contact your family now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話できます。私を階段で待つのではなく、エレベーターを降りた先で会うと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話でき階段ではなくエレベーターを降りた先で会うと伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can call them. I want to tell them to meet me beyond the elevator exit rather than wait for me at the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can call and want to meet beyond the elevator exit, rather than at the stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合流場所を確かめてから連絡しましょう。図では、降りた先に通路が二つあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's confirm the meeting place before you call. The map shows two passages after leaving the elevator.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どちらも改札へ行くと思っていました。ベビーカーで通る経路と、家族に伝える目印を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二経路とも改札と思ったがベビーカー経路と合流目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought both led to the ticket gates. Please show me the stroller route and a landmark to tell my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you thought both routes led to the gates, and ask for the stroller route and a meeting landmark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示のある通路を図でたどりましょう。目印は案内板の前にすると説明しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's trace the marked passage on the map. Meeting in front of the information board would be easy to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板の前と伝えます。エレベーターの前で待つ人が多い場合は、どう待てばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内板を目印にしエレベーター待ちが多い場合の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell them in front of the information board. If many people are waiting at the elevator, how should I wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the information board as a landmark and ask where to wait if the elevator queue is crowded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口と通路をふさがない位置でお待ちください。案内が分からなければ近くの係へ尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Wait where you won't block the entrance or passage. If you don't understand the guidance, ask nearby staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路を空けて待ち、順番や経路が分からないときは係へ聞きます。家族には先に目印を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け不明な順番経路は係へ聞き家族へ目印を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the passage clear while waiting and ask staff if I don't understand the order or route. I'll tell my family the landmark first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the passage clear, ask staff about an unclear queue or route, and tell your family the landmark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、図の経路を確かめてお進みください。ご家族と合流して、よいお出かけを。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then check the route on the map before proceeding. Enjoy your outing after meeting your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居のご相談ですね。新しい住所はメモしていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're consulting about a move. Have you noted your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありますが、契約書の建物名と入口の看板の名前が違います。どちらを書けばよいか分からず相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約書と入口看板の建物名が違い記入に迷っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but the building name on the contract differs from the entrance sign. I came because I don't know which to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the building names on the contract and entrance sign differ, leaving you unsure what to write. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここだけで正式な表記を決めず、二つの情報を担当に見てもらいましょう。部屋番号も異なりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than deciding the official form here, let's show both to the staff. Is the room number different too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 部屋番号は同じです。建物名だけ違うので、契約書の写しと看板の写真を並べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部屋番号は同じで名称だけ違い契約写しと写真を並べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The room number is the same. Only the building name differs, so I'll put the contract copy and sign photo side by side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that only the building name differs, not the room number, and place the contract copy and photo together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 違う箇所が分かりますね。管理の方に表記について聞いてみましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That makes the difference clear. Have you asked building management about the name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。昔の名前かもしれませんが、そう決めずに管理の方へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧称と推測せず管理者に表記の違いを尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. It may be an old name, but I won't assume that; I'll check with management.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask management about the difference rather than assuming it is the former name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認した返答も伝えてください。転居日など、ほかに分かっている情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell us the reply you receive too. Do you know any other information, such as your moving date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先週の金曜日に住み始めました。日付はメモにありますが、書類の持ち物はまだ確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金曜日に入居し日付メモはあるが持ち物は不明と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I started living there last Friday. I have the date noted, but haven't checked which documents to bring yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you moved in on Friday and have a date note, but do not know what to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の状況を担当に伝え、持ち物も確認しましょう。今日、どの点から尋ねますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Explain your situation to the staff and check what to bring too. What will you ask about first today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの建物名の扱いを先に説明し、相談する窓口と準備する書類を聞きます。空欄を推測で埋めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名称の相違から説明して窓口と書類を聞き不明欄を推測記入しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first explain the two building names, then ask which counter to consult and what documents to prepare. I won't fill unknown fields by guessing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Start with the name difference, ask for the counter and documents, and do not guess answers for unknown fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、契約書と写真で相違点を確認しましょう。管理の方の返答も控えておいてください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's compare the contract and photo. Keep a note of management's reply too. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の変更についてですね。電話でのご案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about changing an appointment. Do you have the information given by phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 候補の日を聞いてメモしました。家族に送迎を頼みましたが、この日で予約が決まったのか自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 候補を聞き家族に送迎を頼んだが予約確定か自信がないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I noted a possible date. I've asked my family for a ride, but I'm not sure whether that date was actually booked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you heard a possible date and asked family for transport, but are unsure the booking is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 電話で候補を聞いたことと、変更が確定したことは分けて確認しましょう。返答はどう伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's distinguish hearing an option by phone from a confirmed change. What reply did you give?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族に相談してから連絡すると答えました。その後まだ電話していないので、確定とは言えないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族相談後に連絡すると言いまだ連絡していないため未確定と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I said I would call after discussing it with my family. I haven't called since, so I can't say it's confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you promised to call after consulting family but have not yet called, so it is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に現在の予約を確かめましょう。ご家族が送迎できる時間は分かりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your current appointment with the staff. Do you know when your family can drive you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 候補日の午後なら送迎できます。午前は難しいので、時刻も含めて担当へ希望を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 午後は可能で午前困難なため時刻を含め希望を担当に伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: They can take me and bring me back in the afternoon of the proposed date. Morning is difficult, so I want to tell the staff my preferred time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that afternoon transport is possible but morning is difficult, and you want to tell staff your preferred time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 希望を伝えて空きを確認してください。元の予約の紙はまだありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell them your preference and check availability. Do you still have the original appointment paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。候補のメモとは別に保管し、変更が決まるまでは元の日時を消さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の紙と候補メモを別に保管し確定まで日時を消さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll keep it separate from the note of the alternative and won't erase the original date and time until the change is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the original paper and alternative-date note separately, and do not erase the date and time before confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更が決まった際はご家族にも新しい日時を確認してもらいましょう。何を復唱しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once changed, have your family confirm the new date and time too. What will you repeat back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日付だけでなく曜日と時刻も読み返します。確定した返答を記録してから、家族へ送迎を改めて頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付曜日時刻を確認し確定返答を記録して送迎を再度頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read back the date, day of the week and time. After recording the confirmed answer, I'll ask my family again for transport.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the date, weekday and time, record the confirmed reply, and ask for transport again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当への確認をご案内します。予約の紙とメモをお持ちになって、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll guide you to the responsible staff for confirmation. Take your appointment paper and note, and take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないのですね。ご自身の自転車でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: The bicycle is missing. Is it your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人から借りたものです。自分の自転車ではないので、車体の番号をすぐ答えられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人の自転車を借りており番号を即答できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I borrowed it from an acquaintance. It isn't mine, so I can't immediately give you the frame number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the bicycle is borrowed from an acquaintance and you cannot immediately give its number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 借りた経緯と、最後に停めた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me how you borrowed it and where you last parked it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の朝に借りて、昼に施設の駐輪区画へ停めました。停めた場所は自分のメモで確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝に借り昼に施設駐輪区画へ停め場所メモがあると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I borrowed it this morning and parked it in the facility's bicycle area at noon. I can confirm the location with my own note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you borrowed it in the morning, parked in the facility's bicycle area at noon, and have a location note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: メモを見せてください。車体の色や、見分けられる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show me the note. What color is it, and does it have distinguishing features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 黒色で、後ろに黄色い反射板があります。貸主の写真もありますが、今の状態と同じか確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒色と黄反射板を伝え貸主写真が現状と一致か未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's black, with a yellow reflector at the back. I have the owner's photo too, but haven't checked whether it matches the current condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the black color and yellow reflector, and say you haven't confirmed the owner's photo matches its current condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真の情報と、ご自身が見た特徴を分けて伝えてください。貸主へ連絡できそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Separate the photo's information from the features you saw yourself. Can you contact the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡します。車体番号の分かる書類と、写真を撮った時期を尋ね、撮影後に付けた物がないかも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車体番号資料と撮影時期と撮影後の付属物の有無を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll contact them. I'll ask for documents showing the frame number and when the photo was taken, and check whether anything was added afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the frame-number documents, photo date, and any accessories added since the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 施設の管理の方にも状況を確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you also checked the situation with facility management?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。自分の駐輪メモで場所を示して、移動の案内があるか聞きます。貸主からの返答と合わせて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駐輪メモを施設に示し移動案内を聞いて貸主返答と整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I'll show the location using my parking note and ask whether there is any information about it being moved. I'll organize that with the owner's reply for the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show facility staff the parking note, ask about relocation information, and organize it with the owner's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身の記録と貸主の情報をそろえてお知らせください。確認に戻る際もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please gather your own records and the owner's information and let us know. Take care when going back to check too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類を送るご相談ですね。中には原本を入れる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about sending documents. Will you be including originals?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。番号で追跡できる方法にすれば、手続きが終わった原本も戻ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追跡方法なら手続き後に原本も戻ると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought that using a method tracked by number would also mean the originals return after processing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought trackable mailing meant originals would also return after processing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送の記録と、送り先が原本を返すかどうかは別の確認です。返送の案内は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The mailing record and whether the recipient returns originals are separate questions. Have you received return instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ見ていません。追跡の有無だけで選ばず、送り先の返送案内を先に読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追跡の有無だけで決めず未確認の送り先返送案内を読むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't looked yet. Rather than choosing only by tracking, I want to read the recipient's return instructions first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the unchecked return instructions before deciding solely based on tracking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内が分かれば、その条件に合わせて相談できます。提出する書類の写しは残せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once you understand the instructions, we can discuss a method fitting those conditions. Can you keep copies of the documents you submit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写しを作れます。原本を入れる前に内容を確かめ、自分の控えと発送した物を区別して残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内容を確かめ写しを作って送付物と自分の控えを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can make copies. I'll check the contents before putting in the originals, and keep a record distinguishing my copies from what I sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the contents, make copies, and distinguish the mailed items from your own retained copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それも整理しておきましょう。送り先へ質問するときは、何を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's organize that too. What will you ask the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原本が必要か、戻してもらえるか、返送用に準備する物があるかを尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本要否と返却可否と返送準備物の三点を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask whether originals are needed, whether they can be returned, and whether I must prepare anything for their return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask three things: whether originals are required, whether they can be returned, and what to prepare for return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返送の条件は送り先で確認し、発送方法は内容と希望する記録で相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check return conditions with the recipient, then discuss mailing based on the contents and record you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返答をメモして持ってきます。追跡できることと配達の記録も案内で比べ、原本の返送とは分けて選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返答メモを持参し追跡と配達記録を比較して原本返送とは別に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll bring a note of the reply. I'll also compare tracking and delivery records in the guidance, choosing separately from the originals' return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bring a note of the reply, compare tracking and delivery records, and choose separately from the return of originals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、案内の確認が済んでからご相談ください。原本と控えを混ぜないよう、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then consult us after checking the instructions. Keep originals separate from your copies, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しく口座を作るご相談ですね。どなたが、どのように使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're thinking of opening an account. Who will use it, and how?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族の共通の支出をまとめたいです。私が申し込めば家族も同じように使えると思っていたので、条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の申込みで家族も同様に使えると思ったため条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to consolidate shared family expenses. I thought that if I applied, my family could use it the same way, so I'd like to ask about the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about conditions because you thought your application would let family use the account in the same way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込む方と、利用する方の希望は分けて確認が必要です。ご自身の用途を説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the applicant and wishes for users separately. Can you explain your own intended use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は家賃などの支払いを管理したいです。家族にも支払いを頼む場合があるので、その方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は家賃管理で家族へ支払いを頼む場合の方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to manage rent and similar payments. I may also ask family members to make payments, so I'd like to discuss how that can work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will manage rent and want advice on how family might make payments for you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用の方法は担当へ確認しましょう。すでにお持ちの口座とは目的が違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the usage methods with the staff. Is its purpose different from your existing account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の口座は自分の生活費用です。新しいものは家計の共通費用と分けたいのですが、必ず別口座にするとはまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分生活費と共通家計を分けたいが別口座は未決定と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My current account is for my own living costs. I'd like to separate shared household costs, but haven't definitely decided on another account yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to separate personal living costs and shared household costs, but another account is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 目的を整理してから方法を比べられますね。申込みに使う書類は、必要なものを確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can compare methods after clarifying the purpose. Have you checked the documents needed for applying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認していません。自分の状況を伝えて書類を聞き、家族の書類も要るかを担当に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認と伝え自分の状況と家族書類の要否を担当に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I'll explain my situation and ask about documents, and ask the staff whether my family's documents are needed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you haven't checked, explain your situation, and ask staff whether family documents are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した条件は家族にも共有してください。今日すぐに申込むご予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Share the confirmed conditions with your family too. Do you plan to apply immediately today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は説明を聞き、誰がどう利用するか家族と話してから判断します。条件と必要書類をメモして帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は説明と書類条件をメモし家族で利用方法を話してから決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll hear the explanation, then decide after discussing who will use it and how with my family. I'll take home notes of the conditions and required documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that today you will note the explanation, conditions and documents, and decide after discussing family usage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。用途のメモで担当へ相談しましょう。ご家族とのお話がまとまりましたら、またどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's consult the staff using your notes on the purpose. Please come again once you've discussed it with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 価格の表示についてでしょうか。どの札をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the price display? Which label did you see?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらの低い価格です。隣に会員と書いてありますが、持っているカードを出せばよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会員とある低い価格を所持カードで使えると思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This lower price. It says members beside it, but I thought I could just show the card I have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought your card would let you use the lower price marked for members. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 札の対象となる条件を確認しましょう。お持ちのカードは、この店のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the conditions on that label. Is your card from this store?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の店のカードでした。同じような色なので取り違えました。通常の価格はどちらの表示ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 色で取り違えたカードは他店用で通常価格の表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's from another store. I mixed them up because the colors are similar. Which display is the normal price?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the card is another store's and was confused by color, then ask which display is the regular price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの表示を見比べて確認します。会員の条件についても説明を聞きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll compare the two displays. Would you like to hear the membership conditions too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞きたいですが、その場で登録するとは決めていません。まず今の自分に当てはまる支払額を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 条件説明は聞くが登録は未決定で現在の支払額を先に知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, but I haven't decided to register immediately. First I want to know the amount that applies to me now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want the explanation but haven't decided to join, and first want the amount currently payable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に条件を確かめてお伝えします。価格が違う場合、買う数も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the conditions with the staff and tell you. If the price differs, will you change the quantity too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、二つ買うつもりでした。自分に適用される価格の合計を聞いてから、一つにするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二つ予定だが適用価格の総額を聞いて一つにするか決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I planned to buy two. I'll ask the total at the price that applies to me before deciding whether to buy just one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you planned two but will hear the applicable total before deciding whether to buy one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合計で比べましょう。商品も札の対象と同じ種類か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's compare totals. We'll also check whether the product is the same type covered by the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋の商品名と札を照合します。会員の表示だけで安いと決めず、対象商品と条件と個数を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋名と札を比べ対象商品と適用条件と個数を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll match the product name on the bag with the label. I won't assume it's cheap just because it says members; I'll check the covered product, conditions and quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the bag's product name and label, and check the eligible product, conditions and quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、商品と札を一緒に確認します。お声かけありがとうございます。よいお買い物を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40220-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's check the product and label together. Thank you for asking. Enjoy your shopping.
